description:
The Requires development register: capabilities a NAMED HUMAN has determined Wix has no surface for. This is the only place that verdict may live, and the only source of the requires-development status — automation is limited to migration-planned, no-need-to-migrate, or pending.

Why the restriction: an agent concluded twice that Wix had no target (gift cards, events) and was wrong both times, because Wix splits capabilities across doc trees and a service plugin reads like an absent write API. A wrong 'impossible' is the most expensive error in this system: it tells a customer to abandon data that could have moved.

Every entry needs `decidedBy` and `decidedOn` alongside the recorded search. Entries are reviewable and reversible: if a target later appears, validation rejects the entry.

capabilities.reason: Fixed product bundles (one purchasable product composed of specific child products with quantities at a set price — WPC Product Bundles' woosb_ids, and the official WooCommerce Product Bundles / Composite Products extensions alike) have no native Wix Stores target: Catalog V3 productType is PHYSICAL | DIGITAL only, with no composed-product entity or child-product references, and order history's parent/child line-item linkage (_woosb_ids / _woosb_parent_id) has no eCom order field to receive it. Interim migration path: the bundle product migrates as a plain stores/product with its derived price frozen at migration-time value, and the composition lands in a CMS collection keyed by the product crosswalk — the same shape Wix's own Velo 'Bundle Products' package uses.
capabilities.searched: bundle, composite product, product kit, product set, child products — dev.wix.com and support.wix.com (2026-08-16, WebSearch/WebFetch): Catalog V3 product-object.md (productType PHYSICAL|DIGITAL only); dev.wix.com/docs/velo/articles/velo-package-readmes/wix-stores-bundle-products (Velo site-code pattern: plain product + CMS Bundles collection, not a write API); support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-selling-mix-and-match-product-bundles — evaluated 2026-08-16 at Spec Owner's request: mix-and-match is a category + automatic-discount pattern for customer-assembled combos (no fixed-bundle SKU, no composed-product entity, no API) and does NOT receive fixed bundles.
capabilities.note: Tracked separately as a Wix API feature request (Stores/Catalog: bundle/composite product type writable at creation). Per the owner-ask policy, a gap with a working workaround (CMS composition) gets no standalone owner task. Reversible: if Catalog V3 gains a bundle primitive, validation rejects this entry once a target entity claims the capability.

capabilities.reason: Dropshipping supplier-linkage: no general-merchant-facing Wix write API represents linking a store's products to an external dropshipping supplier's catalog/fulfillment feed.

evidence.searched: dropshipping supplier catalog sync; supplier fulfillment linkage; dropship product import API
evidence.found: The business-solutions tree does have a Marketplace Suppliers API (suppliers-hub) whose Supplier object carries a DROPSHIPPING/WHOLESALE type -- but per its own docs, quoted verbatim: "This API is available only to approved Wix business partners and requires a signed business agreement with Wix. To apply for partnership, contact jills@wix.com." Its `Supplier` models the marketplace-provider relationship (an entity that supplies a Wix *marketplace provider*, who then resells to end users), not a per-product external-supplier link an ordinary merchant's own store can create on its own products. The other hits ("Extensions and APIs for Dropshipping Apps", Catalog V3) are for *building* a dropshipping-supplier app that provides products TO other Wix stores (an SPI direction), or for generic inventory/stock management -- neither is a write path for importing an existing store's own supplier-linkage configuration.
evidence.conclusion: SPI / partner-gated surface, not a general write API reachable by a normal site migration. No import path exists today for this capability.

No general write API found.
